payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for different discourse relations, indicating which types the model performs best and worst on.

claims.text: The ensemble model achieves the best performance for predicting both implicit and explicit discourse relations simultaneously.

The paragraph-level neural network model achieves the best macro-average F1-score of 48.82% in predicting implicit discourse relations, indicating it works best for these relations compared to previous models.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing minority discourse relations, particularly in Comparison and Temporal categories, suggesting it works well for these specific types.
Explicit discourse relations have achieved reasonable performance (F1 score > 90%), indicating the model works best for explicit relations compared to implicit ones.
